decisions.reason: The level-4 bullet color is owned by the bullet-design Requirement; the existing catalog source and all-template deployment rule remain unchanged.
Changing the level-4 bullet to green does not change the independently required theme-color palette; the theme-color clause reports an implementation failure already recorded for this candidate.
Bullet color does not alter Tab-key sublevel creation, hierarchy alignment, or the unresolved style-ribbon interaction.
The green level-4 bullet specification does not change the required PBU style-name prefix or its applicability.
Bullet color does not change named-style typography; the caption typography in the same message is a separate clause already represented by the candidate's MODIFY.
The level-4 bullet color does not affect alignment of numbered lists at double-digit values.
The bullet-color specification does not change the required layout or style stability of legacy-content transfer.
The source changes a bullet appearance value but does not alter the supported Word environment or cross-user stability requirement.
The green bullet requirement is independent of pasted-table containment and layout stability.
The bullet-color change does not affect creation of manual line breaks after pasted content.
The source does not change the language used for template style names.
A green level-4 bullet does not change whether interactive-field help labels are required; the label typography clause concerns image and table text rather than this candidate's label-presence rule.
